data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'rande,' meaning 'corner' or 'edge.' The name Randie evolved from the Old Norse name 'Randger,' which means 'counselor' or 'adviser.' In the Middle Ages, 'rand' came to mean 'free,' and the name Randie could be interpreted as 'free advisor' or 'free counselor.'. The name Randie carries the meaning “Free, Clever, Adviser” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Randie usually hope their child will grow to embody free, clever, adviser and live with faith, good character and purpose.
